text:
maria.nguyen: Quick internal: opening a tiny H100v2x Dedicated preview in Cape Verde (cv-west-1) today. Aim: ultra-low-latency Atlantic routes and partner trials. :sparkles:

kevin.lopez: Nice. Any changes to reservation/cancellation policies for this preview?

maria.nguyen: Policy update for previews: 7-day reservation window available. Cancellation within 48h of start will incur a soft reallocation fee (internal credit) to deter churn. No formal SLA until GA.

sre-bot: [automated] pool-create: dedicated-h100v2x-cv-west-1-a created (6x H100v2x). Telemetry and crashdump collection enabled.

ops-runbook: Quick runbook:
```
# reserve preview pool
rcli reserve --region cv-west-1 --gpu H100v2x --count 1 --days 7
# list pools in region
rcli pool list --region cv-west-1
# cancel (note: fee if <48h)
rcli reserve cancel --id <reservation-id> --reason "change-of-plans"
```

kevin.lopez: Autoscale? preemption? billing details?

maria.nguyen: Autoscaling disabled; small pools are subject to soft preemption outside reservation windows. Billing uses standard dedicated SKU; effective per-unit costs may be higher for preview until we scale.

sales-apac: Heads-up for account teams: do not promise GA SLAs to customers. Offer partner trials with engineering support and document the cancellation fee in the trial agreement.

sre-bot: [automated] alert rule created: h100v2x-cv-west-1-therm (warn 82%, critical 94%).

maria.nguyen: We'll review telemetry at 72h and share a decision on expanding pool sizes or enabling burst. I'll post a short update here then. Thanks all :rocket:
